# UNICO Built Environments

> UNICO is an award-winning national construction and built-environment powerhouse specializing in high-rise structural engineering, sub-millimeter trade precision, 3D BIM spatial matrix coordination, and 7D BIM cloud digital twin handovers. Operating since 1981 across 450+ completed landmark developments with a verified 0.00% structural settlement rate.

---

## Company Information

- [Company Heritage & Overview](https://unico-content.com/index.html#story): Four decades of structural engineering excellence, 380M+ sq ft constructed, and verified 0.00% structural settlement rate.
- [Core Principles & Engineering Code](https://unico-content.com/index.html#principles): Six non-negotiable engineering principles governing ISO 17025 concrete core break testing (10,000+ PSI), sub-millimeter 0.5mm survey accuracy, ISO 45001 safety, and 32.4% carbon reduction.
- [Core Identity & Capability Matrix](https://unico-content.com/index.html#who-we-are): Architectural identity defined by three core pillars: Grounded in structural discipline, Precise in sub-millimeter execution, and Accountable through single-source ownership.

---

## Products

- [7D BIM Digital Twin Handover Models](https://unico-content.com/index.html#quality): Cloud-native 3D asset models embedded with component specs, maintenance schedules, and structural asset data for facility management.
- [Unitized Facade & Building Envelopes](https://unico-content.com/index.html#build-sequence): Custom unitized curtain walls, dynamic terracotta rainscreens, and triple-glazed structural glass stress-tested against 180 MPH hurricane-force winds.
- [High-Performance Concrete Assemblies](https://unico-content.com/index.html#quality): ISO 17025 verified 10,000+ PSI compressive strength concrete core formulations and post-tensioned floor slab assemblies.

---

## Services

- [High-Rise Structural Engineering](https://unico-content.com/index.html#build-sequence): Substructure caisson drilling, self-climbing hydraulic core formwork, and high-tensile steel framing up to 60+ stories.
- [Pre-Construction 3D Utility Mapping](https://unico-content.com/index.html#clients): Underground radar sweeps and constructability modeling reducing budget variance to <0.1%.
- [ISO 17025 Materials Testing & Metallurgy](https://unico-content.com/index.html#quality): Ultrasonic weld verification, GPR scans, and 7, 14, 28-day concrete compression break testing.
- [Single-Source General Contracting](https://unico-content.com/index.html#clients): End-to-end project execution under single-source engineer accountability.

---

## Solutions

- [Zero-Deflection Floor Screeding](https://unico-content.com/index.html#build-sequence): Automated laser screed technology delivering floor levelness ratings 40.8% above national ACI standards.
- [3D BIM Clash Elimination Matrix](https://unico-content.com/index.html#build-sequence): Spatial matrix coordination eliminating 99.4% of field mechanical, electrical, and plumbing conflicts prior to site delivery.
- [Subterranean Hydrostatic Waterproofing](https://unico-content.com/index.html#build-sequence): Multi-redundant waterproofing systems engineered to withstand 150 PSI subterranean water pressures.
